title: Does God Play Favorites?
summaryZh: 神不偏待人，在祂的國度裡沒有比較的空間，我們只需專注於祂賦予的使命。
lines: Who do you compare yourself to?
Even though they don't mean to, who makes you feel like you're not quite as good as they are?
即使他們不是有意的，有誰會讓你覺得自己比不上他們？
Maybe because they seem better at the job, or better at mothering, smarter, skinnier—all the things, right?
也許是因為他們在工作上表現更好，或是更會當媽媽、更聰明、更苗條——各方面都更好，對吧？
I tend to compare myself to people that I'm closest to, like my sister and my friends and people at work.
我傾向於和最親近的人比較，像是我的姊妹、朋友和同事。
In my mind, when I naturally see them excelling at something, I look at myself and I size myself up to them.
在我心裡，當我自然而然看到他們在某件事上表現優異時，我就會看看自己，並且拿自己跟他們比較。
And that's why Scripture like today's verse starts to heal my wrong way of thinking about myself.
這就是為什麼像今天這段經文開始醫治我對自己錯誤的想法。
See, God does not size us up.
你看，神並不會那樣評估我們。
In fact, if anything, He sees people like me who feel weak and less than, and He affirms that we are worthy of being part of His kingdom.
事實上，如果有什麼不同的話，祂看見像我這樣感到軟弱和不如人的人，並且祂肯定我們配得成為祂國度的一份子。
That's what Paul was talking about as he wrote to the Galatian church.
這正是保羅在寫給加拉太教會的信中所談到的。
He reminded them that he was the least of the apostles, but that God had commissioned him for this great work of spreading the gospel.
他提醒他們，他是使徒中最小的，但神還是委派他去完成傳揚福音這項偉大的工作。
He said, "For those who were held in high esteem—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—they added nothing to my message."
他說：「至於那些有名望的，不論他是何等人，都與我無干。神不偏待人。那些有名望的，並沒有加增我甚麼。」
The people others thought were awesome didn't affect Paul because he knew that God didn't favor them over him, or him over them.
那些別人認為很了不起的人並沒有影響保羅，因為他知道神不會偏袒他們勝過他，也不會偏袒他勝過他們。
God doesn't play our earthly favoritism games.
神不玩我們世上那種偏心對待的遊戲。
I need that same reminder so badly—that I don't need anyone to add, including myself, to any of the missions God is giving me.
我非常需要同樣的提醒——我不需要任何人，包括我自己，來加添神所賜給我的任何使命。
Others may naturally excel more than I do, but God is the one equipping me to do the job that He's called me to.
別人天生可能比我更優秀，但神是裝備我去做祂呼召我去做之工的那位。
And the same is true of you.
God isn't any more or less impressed with you than He is with me.
神對你的看重，不會比對我多，也不會比對我少。
He's called you to partner in His great kingdom, to share in the power of the gospel as you live out His love to those around you like only you can.
祂呼召你參與在祂偉大的國度中，當你以只有你能做到的方式，向周遭的人活出祂的愛時，你就在分享福音的大能。
There's no room for comparison in God's kingdom.
在神的國度裡，沒有比較的空間。
So let's get a little confidence in what God is doing in us today.
因此，讓我們對神今天在我們裡面所做的工作多一點信心吧。
